subject: Post-call exec recap: procurement path, risks & next steps - StellarSys
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: procurement path, risks & next steps - StellarSys

Jordan — great to meet today. Quick executive-level recap for your leadership and procurement thread: 

Summary of outcomes and business goals:
- Primary goal: Replace legacy retrieval system with an LLM-powered semantic search and summarization layer to reduce time-to-insight for customer support by 70% and deflect Tier 1 tickets.
- Success metrics discussed: 60% reduction in average handle time for support cases in pilot; 0.5s median inference latency for production queries; <10% regression in response relevance vs current baseline.

Pain points & constraints:
- Data residency & on-prem connector: StellarSys requires private deployment or VPC with strict egress controls for PII-containing logs.
- Procurement timeline: leadership wants a 60–90 day pilot approved by Finance/Procurement/Legal.
- Risk: integration with a legacy on-prem DB may require a custom connector and bandwidth for data transfer during ingest.

Suggested procurement path & next steps:
1) Internal alignment: Confirm executive sponsor (you mentioned Ava Roth, CTO).
2) Security artifacts: We can provide SOC 2 snapshot, SSO/SCIM checklist, and architecture diagram for the Private deployment.
3) Mutual Action Plan (attached): Proposed milestones — kickoff, data onboarding, POC (30 days), exec review, procurement sign-off.
4) Pricing/POC: We recommended a 6-week POC on Dedicated capacity with an optional credit for proof-of-concept; I’ve flagged this for commercial review.

Attachments: stellarsys-exec-summary.pdf, stellarsys-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Next meeting: propose a short procurement + security sync week of May 10. Jordan — can you confirm preferred attendees and any mandatory legal terms?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ava Roth <ava.roth@stellarsys.com>, procure@stellarsys.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 18:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: procurement path, risks & next steps - StellarSys

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa — really helpful. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Exec sponsor: Ava Roth (CTO) will own the pilot approval. She asked to see SOC2 evidence and an SSO/SCIM implementation plan before scheduling Procurement.
- Procurement contact: procure@stellarsys.com (looped) — they’ll need an outline of deliverables and estimated spend for the POC to create an initial purchase request.
- Timeline: aiming for kickoff between May 17–21 if security checks pass; legal has flagged one data residency clause that may need a short exception for the POC.

A couple of asks for Redwood: 
1) SOC2 summary / system description we can share with Legal.
2) SSO/SCIM setup guide and any FedRAMP/region controls (we’re US-first).
3) A 1-page pricing estimate for a 6-week Dedicated POC (token estimates + infra + optional support add-on).

If you can share those by EOD Tuesday (May 4) we’ll get Procurement and Legal to review before the week of May 10.

Jordan
Jordan Hayes
Head of Platform Integrations | StellarSys
jordan.hayes@stellarsys.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stellarsys.com>, procure@stellarsys.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: procurement path, risks & next steps - StellarSys

Jordan / Procurement team — attaching the items you requested for legal/security review. See attachments and links below.

Included:
- redwood-soc2-snapshot.pdf (condensed summary for vendor review)
- SSO_SCIM_checklist.md (implementation checklist and timeline) — link included
- Pricing estimate (summary): 6-week Dedicated POC — $28,000 (includes up to 100M tokens, monitoring + 2 support hours/week). Line items available on the attached MAP.

Notes on Private/On-prem connector:
- We can support a Private VPC deployment with customer-managed networking. A short architecture review will surface whether a thin ingestion appliance or a secure SFTP + transformer pipeline is best. This typically takes one week for assessment.

Proposed next steps:
- Procurement sync: Wed, May 12 at 10:00 AM PT (30 mins) — I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.
- Security: share SOC2 snapshot and SSO checklist with Legal, let us know any follow-ups.
- Commercial: Aditya (cc) — can you confirm credit approval for a POC (we typically authorize a pilot credit on a case-by-case basis)?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-snapshot.pdf, stellarsys-mutual-action-plan.xlsx
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/SSO_SCIM_checklist.md

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call exec recap: procurement path, risks & next steps - StellarSys

Laura / Sean — forwarding the thread for visibility. Action items and escalation notes below (commercial + security):

Commercial/Deal: 
- Aditya to confirm whether we can approve a $5k pilot credit for the 6-week POC (requested in the MAP). This is a standard concession to accelerate procurement.
- If approved, approve the credit and confirm how it should appear on the quote (line item). Deal ID: DEAL-2027-7741.

Security/Delivery risk: 
- Customer requires Private/VPC deployment or on-prem connector for PII data. This will likely require an infra assessment and engage the Private deployments team. Estimate: 1 week assessment + 3–4 weeks delivery of connector if custom work is required.
- Raise a potential SLA exception for the pilot if they need accelerated timeline; we should document expected latency targets and fallback (hosted variant).

Requesting next steps: 
- Laura: please prioritize a short security intake with the Private deployments team and confirm capacity for a May 17 kickoff if assessment completes by May 12.
- Sean: FYI on potential credit; please advise if the $5k is fine from a commercial standpoint or if it needs VP approval.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the procurement sync once Jordan confirms attendees.

Marissa
-- End of thread --
